title: Compassion
definition: Compassion is heartfelt concern that moves toward the suffering, needy, weak, and broken with mercy and help.
summary: Biblical compassion is more than emotion. It sees need, moves toward people, and acts in love according to wisdom and truth.
christFocus: Jesus was moved with compassion and ministered to the sick, hungry, lost, grieving, and burdened.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Biblical compassion is more than emotion. It sees need, moves toward people, and acts in love according to wisdom and truth.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
